summary: The Ark 21Shares Bitcoin ETF filed an 8-K to disclose a new Benchmark Licensing Agreement with FTSE International, replacing the terminated CF Benchmarks agreement for the pricing benchmark used in NAV calculations, effective August 27, 2026. Also, the Trust amended its Sponsor Agreement to change sponsor fee payment timing from weekly to at least quarterly in arrears, payable in bitcoin, and adopted a Second Amended and Restated Trust Agreement. These are routine operational changes for an ETF, not a special situation such as an acquisition or restructuring.
